//: DEP-2: records the provenance of the vendored front-end libraries and gives them an update path (`libman restore` / `libman update`). Those commands need the LibMan CLI, which is NOT in .config/dotnet-tools.json — install it first with `dotnet tool install -g Microsoft.Web.LibraryManager.Cli`, otherwise `dotnet libman` reports 'command not found' in a fresh clone. Only the files the app actually references are kept, trimming the previously-full Bootstrap dist. Bump the version here and run `libman update` to update.
